HPX_PRINTERS_DETAILS.py.class_summary: HPXPrinterDetails is an Android UI page class for HP Smart app printer details screen automation. It extends SmartFlow and provides comprehensive methods for interacting with printer tiles (scan, print, copy, fax, shortcuts), product information retrieval, printer reports, and device management. The class implements robust retry patterns with swipe gestures for element discovery, explicit waits with configurable timeouts, conditional element handling, and fallback mechanisms including coordinate-based gestures. Notable patterns include: swipe-to-find with max retry logic, optional popup handling, data extraction with text retrieval, and navigation flows for printer information and reports.
